bindu.cp: neut. a drop; a dot; a trifle.
bindu.p: [Vida+ku] (pu,na) Google Translate ဝိ ဒ +⁇. Vidi + egg. မောဂ်၊ 7.6. ဒါန်၊ ထီ. 129, ⁇ 76၊ 660.] (1) a spot; Dots. (A) Zero. (B) Niggahit. Vindusa Hita Vijnana: See (2) Vindhu Mathematics. Vin Dutthani - Look.
a: ဗိန္ဒု(ပု၊န)

B:
bindu：bindu（pu，na）
ဗိန္ဒု（ပု၊န）
[vida+ku．vida+u．vidi+u．，7．6．，ṭī．129，476，66va．]
[ဝိဒ+ကု။ ဝိဒ+ဥ။ ဝိဒိ+ဥ။ မောဂ်၊ ၇။၆။ ဓာန်၊ ဋီ။ ၁၂၉၊ ၄၇၆၊ ၆၆ဝ။]
C: bindu：[nt．] a drop; a dot; a trifle．
P: Bindu，[cp．Vedic bindu & vindu] 1．a drop，usually a drop of water Sn．392，812 （uda°）; J．I，100; Vism．531 （madhu°）; ThA．281; PvA．98 （udaka°）．-- 2．a spot （cp．SBE XVII．155） Vism．222 （°vicitvā gāvī a spotted cow）．‹-› 3．（as adj．） one of the eight qualities of perfect sound （brahma-ssara，with ref．to the voice of Brahmā and of Buddha，cp．aṭṭhaṅga），which are given at D．II，211= 227 as （saro hoti） vissaṭṭho ca viññeyyo ca mañjū ca savanīyo ca bindu [vv．ll．bandu & bhindu] ca avisārī ca gambhīro ca ninnādī ca．We may translate by “full，close，compact＂ （Dial．II．245 “continuous＂）．See also below °ssara． --tthanī having breasts round as a bubble J．V，215．--bindu（ṁ） drop by drop DA．I，218．--matī （f．） Np．of a courtesan of Pāṭaliputta in the time of Asoka Miln．121 sq．--matta measuring a drop，even a drop PvA．100，104 （eka °ṁ）．--sāra Np．of king of India，father of Asoka Dpvs．V，101; VI，15; Mhvs．V，18，19．--ssara a full rounded voice Sn．350 （referred by SnA to a Mahāpurisa）; adj．having a full voice （see above bindu 3） Pv III，34 （T．vindu°，BB bindu°; PvA．explns by avissaṭṭha-ssara sampiṇḍita-ssara，i．e．“continuous＂）; J．II，439 （=bindhunā avisaṭena piṇḍitena sarena samannāgata C．）; V，204，299 （=sampiṇḍita-ghana-ssara）; VI，518=581 （=piṇḍita-ssara C．）．（Page 487）
I: bindu：A drop; a spot; a little circle or dot used as a symbol for anusvāra; one of the high numerals，10，000，000（to the 7th power） or 1 followed by 49 ciphers
K:
bindu：ဗိန္ဒု（ပု၊န）
[ဝိဒ+ကု။ ဝိဒ+ဥ။ ဝိဒိ+ဥ။ မောဂ်၊ ၇။၆။ ဓာန်၊ ဋီ။ ၁၂၉၊ ၄၇၆၊ ၆၆ဝ။]
（၁） အစက်အပြောက်၊ အစက်အပေါက်။ （က） သုည၊ ဝလုံး။ （ခ） နိဂ္ဂဟိတ်။ ဗိန္ဒုသဟိတဗျဉ္ဇန-ကြည့်။ （၂） ဗိန္ဒုသင်္ချာ။ （တိ） （၃） မကွဲမအက် တစ်ခဲနက်လုံးသော （အသံ）။ （၄） လုံးဝန်းသော။ ဗိန္ဒုတ္ထနီ-ကြည့်။
R:
bindu：ဗိန္ဒု （ပ）
အစက်။ အပေါက်။ နိဂ္ဂဟိတ်။ ၁ နောက်သုညရေ ၄၉ ရှိသော သချၤာသဒ္ဒါ။
DOP: bindu vindu n. and mfn. [ cf S. bindu, vindu], 1. ( n. ) ( i ) a drop; a drop of water; a minute particle; Abh 660 (thevo tu ~u); 1115 (kaṇe ~u); Sp 437, 28* (tilatelassa yathā ~u); Ps II 322, 9 (na ca ~u ~u udakaṃ paggharati) = Mp III 233, 10 ( Be, Se so; Ce, Ee na iminā udakaṃ) = Sv 218, 9 ( Be, Se ~uṃ ~uṃ; Ce, Ee bindubinduṃ; cf bindubindu below ); Dhp-a III 208, 11 (vassavalāhakaṃ pi āṇāpesi mahantamahantāni ~ūni pātehī ti); — ifc see uda- ( sv uda 3 ), ussāva- ( sv ussāva 1 ); — ( ii ) a spot; a round mark; the dot representing the anusvāra; Abh 1115 (niggahīte … ~u); As 138, 33 (nalāṭe ekam eva manosilābinduṃ kareyyuṃ … nānāvaṇṇehi pana parivāretvā ~ūsu katesu cittatilako nāma hoti); Sadd 606, 21 (rassattayato paraṃ ~u niggahītaṃ nāmā ti daṭṭhabbaṃ); — ifc see kappa-; — ( iii ) a high numeral; Abh 475 (akkhohiṇī … ~u abbudaṃ); Sadd 801, 26 (ninnahutasatasahassānaṃ sataṃ akkhobhanī tathā ~u); — 2. ( mfn. ) a quality of a sound: compact; rounded and deep; Abh 129; D II 211, 23 (brahmuno sanaṅkumārassa … aṭṭhaṅgasamannāgato saro hoti vissaṭṭho ca … ~u ca avisārī ca …; Sv 640, 31 : ~ū ti ekaghano) ≠ M II 140, 7 (bhoto Gotamassa mukhato ghoso … ~u; Ps III 394, 13 foll.: ~ū ti sampiṇḍito … °-ttā yeva c’ esa avisārī hoti, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se °-tāy’ eva); — °- tthanī , ( m ) f ( n )., with rounded breasts; Ja V 215, 23* (216, 28´ : udakabubbuḷaparimaṇḍalatthanī); — °- bindu , n. , drop after drop; in drops; Sp 511, 12 (~ūni ’ssa sarīrato paggharanti); Ps IV 170, 14 (sarīrato ~-vasena sedā muccanti); Spk II 84, 4 (rukkhassa aṅkuraggesu ~ūni hutvā viya sineho tiṭṭhati); — °- ssara , m. and mfn. [bindu + sara 5 ], 1. ( m. ) a rounded, deep sound or voice; Sn 350 (haṃsā va … nikūja ~ena suvikappitena) = Th 1270 ( Be, Ce, Se so; Ee nikūjaṃ); — 2. ( mfn. ) having a rounded, deep voice; Pv 28:4 (haṃsā … ~ā dundubhīnaṃ va ghoso; Pv-a 189, 9 : ~ā ti avissaṭṭhassarā sampiṇḍitassarā, Be, Ce, Ee vindussarā ti); Ja II 439, 6* (ko ’yaṃ ~o vaggu, Be, Ce, Ee so; Se vindussaro; 439, 8´ : bindunā avisārena piṇḍitena sarena samannāgato, Be so; Ce, Ee avisaṭena; Se vindunā abhisaṇḍena); V 204, 3* (~o nātivisaṭṭhavākyo); VI 518, 24* (~ā … bahū dijā); — see also ghatabinduvilīyana ( sv ghata ).

bindumatta.cp: adj. as much as a drop.

C: bindumatta：[adj．] as much as a drop．

bindumattaṃ：ဗိန္ဒုမတ္တံ

bindussara.p: [Bindu+sara] (pu,na) CL=9 lucid sound. One whose sound is lucid.
a: ဗိန္ဒုဿရ(ပု၊န)
(၁)မကွဲမအက်တစ်ခဲနက်လုံးသောအသံ။(တိ)(၂)မကွဲမအက် တစ်ခဲနက်လုံးသော အသံရှိသော၊ သူ။
